decisions.current_literal: In the console, this team-management area is labeled **Account > Members**. There is no separate **Host Teams** console page; this guide uses "host teams" to describe using **Account > Members** for hosting operations.
decisions.proposed_owner_role: Documentation reviewer with authorized current-console observation

source_refs.source_excerpt: The observed console sidebar groups Members under Account and links to /manage-members/. In the owner team context, that page shows Members and Roles tabs, Invite, and More team options. The sidebar has no Host Teams item.

decisions.support_rationale: The current Members destination and selected-team controls support this navigation. The replacement removes the broader assertion that no separate console page exists.
decisions.method_rationale: Compare the full literal and page context with the selected-account UI observation; image captions also bind the unchanged included image. Navigation and visible fields need no submitted account operation.
decisions.limitation: Observed navigation only; absence from this sidebar is not a proof that no separate route can exist.
decisions.next_action: Recheck after console changes; keep the account-context and non-execution limits.
decisions.replacement_text: In the console, open **Account > Members** to manage the selected team. This guide uses "host teams" to describe using **Account > Members** for hosting operations.

source_refs.source_excerpt: The selected machine Settings dialog has Listing Settings, Machine Maintenances and Problem Reports tabs. Listing Settings displays On-demand Price, Min bid Price, Upload Price, Download Price, Storage Price, Min GPUs Per Instance, Reserved Instance Pricing Factor, Add Volume Disk, volume size/price, Listing expiration date, and Automatically renew contracts after expiration. Cancel, Unlist Machine and Update Listing are visible. Min GPUs Per Instance and Reserved Instance Pricing Factor are disabled in this context. Cancel closed the dialog without any input changes or submission.
The included image shows listing settings for on-demand price, minimum bid, bandwidth, storage, minimum GPUs and expiration.

decisions.support_rationale: The listed categories are visible in both the included image and current dialog. The caption does not claim every control is editable or enumerate every new control.
decisions.method_rationale: Compare the full literal and page context with the selected-account UI observation; image captions also bind the unchanged included image. Navigation and visible fields need no submitted account operation.
decisions.limitation: Field presence only; not edit permission, price calculation, saved configuration or contract behavior.
decisions.next_action: Recheck after console changes; keep the account-context and non-execution limits.

decisions.current_literal: Set an escalation contact for hosted-machine incidents from **Account > Settings**, or open [Settings](https://cloud.vast.ai/settings/). The console asks for an escalation email and phone number.
decisions.proposed_owner_role: Documentation reviewer with authorized current-console observation

source_refs.source_excerpt: At Account > Settings in the owner team context, Escalation Contact is present. Expanding it shows: Provide escalation contact information for urgent issues with your hosted machines. Escalation Email. Escalation Phone Number. Save. The joined host team manager context instead showed Referral Link, Environment Variables, Marketing Emails, Early Access and Discord, without Escalation Contact. No contact was entered or saved.

decisions.support_rationale: The owner context exposes the specified fields, while the inspected manager context does not. The replacement explicitly scopes the instruction to an available section and avoids inventing a universal role rule.
decisions.method_rationale: Compare the full literal and page context with the selected-account UI observation; image captions also bind the unchanged included image. Navigation and visible fields need no submitted account operation.
decisions.limitation: This comparison does not isolate role from account/team configuration; it cannot establish a universal manager-permission rule or contact delivery.
decisions.next_action: Recheck after console changes; keep the account-context and non-execution limits.
decisions.replacement_text: To set an escalation contact for hosted-machine incidents, open **Account > Settings**, or [Settings](https://cloud.vast.ai/settings/), in an account context where **Escalation Contact** is available. The section asks for an escalation email and phone number. If it is unavailable in your selected team, ask the team owner or Vast support which account context to use.

source_refs.source_excerpt: In the owner team context, More team options on the Members page opens a menu containing Edit Team Name, Transfer Team Ownership and Delete Team. No menu option was selected; Escape dismissed the menu.

decisions.support_rationale: The owner-context Members page shows the three-dot More team options control and account-level team actions; only control availability is supported.
decisions.method_rationale: Compare the full literal and page context with the selected-account UI observation; image captions also bind the unchanged included image. Navigation and visible fields need no submitted account operation.
decisions.limitation: Visible owner controls only; no rename, transfer, deletion or permission-enforcement test.
decisions.next_action: Recheck after console changes; keep the account-context and non-execution limits.

decisions.current_literal: Open [Account Settings](https://cloud.vast.ai/account/) and go to **Notification Settings**. Host events appear only when you provide machines on Vast.ai.
decisions.proposed_owner_role: Documentation reviewer with authorized current-console observation

source_refs.source_excerpt: In the individual account context, Account > Settings links to /settings/. The expandable section is labeled Notification and Webhook Settings, and opening it selects /settings/?section=notifications. It contains Account, Instance and Host groups. Host contains Machine offline, Machine verification failed, Machine issue detected, Machine reported by renter, Machine disk space low, Machine listing ending soon and Maintenance window confirmed. Save was disabled. The section was absent from the inspected owner-team and joined manager-team settings views. No notification preference was changed or saved.

decisions.support_rationale: Current UI establishes the corrected destination, section name and Host group. The replacement removes the unsupported exclusive eligibility statement and makes the observed account-context dependency explicit; it does not claim which account governs team notifications.
decisions.method_rationale: Compare the full literal and page context with the selected-account UI observation; image captions also bind the unchanged included image. Navigation and visible fields need no submitted account operation.
decisions.limitation: UI visibility only. The account belongs to host teams; these observations do not establish event eligibility, delivery, persistence, or which account preferences govern team machines.
decisions.next_action: Recheck after console changes; keep the account-context and non-execution limits.
decisions.replacement_text: Open [Account Settings](https://cloud.vast.ai/settings/) and look for **Notification and Webhook Settings**. Host notification controls are grouped under **Host**. If this section is unavailable in your current team context, ask the team owner or Vast support which account context to use.
